definitions.explanation: refers to both options or items equally (in affirmative sentences)
used with negative verbs to mean 'neither of them'

examples.japanese: どちらも{美味|おい}しそうだ。
どちらも⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
どちらも⟦{選|えら}べない→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧なら、⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦{買|か}えば→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: If you can't choose between them, just buy both.

examples.japanese: どちらも⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't like either of them.

examples.japanese: どちらも⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
どちらも⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、どちらも⟦{悪|わる}くない→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Neither is perfect, but neither is bad either.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧ (which one of two) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (inclusive particle)
- どちらも + affirmative → both
- どちらも + negative → neither

CONTRAST WITH {両方|りょうほう}:
- どちらも - emphasizes "both" when choosing between two specific options
- ⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧ - simply means "both" (more neutral)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧ - one or the other
- ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - either is fine
- ⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧ - all of them (for three or more)

REGISTER:
どちらも is slightly more formal than ⟦どっちも→どっちも：25897_docchimo⟧ (casual version).
